title: GroupMobility jitter: O(dt/jitter_update_us) redraw loop is wasteful; clamp path untested
description: _update_jitter (mobility.py:380-382) iterates once per elapsed interval redrawing all-member targets each pass but glide uses only the final draw - replace with %= interval + single redraw (O(1), semantically identical). Also jitter_update_us=1 with giant dt stalls runner linearly. Add tests for dt >> jitter_update_us and the progress=min(1.0,...) clamp path in _move_toward.
